internal.basis: ICRP Publication 60 (1991) tissue weighting factors, ICRP 56 biokinetics
notes: Adult reference person: maximum age code per nuclide — 7300 days (20 yr) for most elements, 9125 days (25 yr) for bone-seekers and actinides (Pu, Am, Cm, Np, Pa, U, Th, Ra, Ba, Sr, Ca, Ac, Pb), per ICRP 56 / FGR13
Inhalation: AMAD = 1.0 µm; maximum over absorption classes (F, M, S, V, ...)
Ingestion: maximum over chemical forms (by f1 gastrointestinal absorption fraction)
L and H LET components are summed; the e_50 column (committed effective dose, Sv/Bq) is used
inhalation_acute == inhalation_chronic; the prior v1.x distinction was a MACCS artifact

update_status.groundshine_8hr: Populated: groundshine_rate x integral_0^8hr exp(-lambda*t) dt
update_status.groundshine_7day: Populated: groundshine_rate x integral_0^7day exp(-lambda*t) dt
update_status.inhalation_acute: FGR13 committed effective dose, adult, max over absorption classes
update_status.inhalation_chronic: Same as inhalation_acute (MACCS provenance artifact removed)
update_status.ingestion: FGR13 committed effective dose, adult, max over chemical forms
